method: RADAR: nearest neighbor(s) in signal space (Euclidean distance) on a recorded radio map; also a propagation model (signal loss with distance and walls)
dataset: Own testbed: one floor (43.5 m x 22.5 m) of an office building; 3 base stations; one laptop
evaluation_protocol: Leave-one-location-out on the radio map: each of the 70 surveyed points (4 orientations each) is located against the other 69 (Sect. 4.1.1)
notes: Median error 2.94 m ('under 3 meters'); no mean given in this passage. Averaging k = 5 neighbors: median 2.75 m, a small gain; a large k made it worse (Sect. 4.1.2). Small own testbed: not comparable with UJIIndoorLoc.
